image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a vintage black typewriter. The image focuses on the keyboard area, showing rows of round, metallic-rimmed keys with dark centers. Above the keys is the type guide and ribbon mechanism. The brand name 'CORONA' is visible in gold lettering on the front panel above the keys. The space bar is the long, horizontal key at the very bottom of the visible keyboard section.
